newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks ride futures to higher close.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks ride futures to higher close.

text.p: The Australian share market flew home to a higher finish on Wednesday, lifted by futures-led buying interest and value seeking investors who saw Tuesday's selloff as overdone.
The All Ordinaries index added 26.7 points to 2,435.8.

Despite the non-arrival of a widely-expected easing in official interest rates, interest on the buy side was enough to see the benchmark more than recoup all of Tuesday's losses and end near its highs for the day.

"There has been solid interest on the buy side for most of the day," said a Sydney broker, pointing to the return of the March SPI future contract to a modest premium after trading at a discount for several weeks.

"Futures generated a lot of the interest, especially in BHP." BHP added over two percent to close at A$17.78 (US$13.57), recovering all of its losses from Tuesday's overdone selling and fractionally firmer than Monday's close.
Other rises were generally widespread, with the miners having slightly the better of it on the day.
